turn-1 (solid line): scenario-run-help-exit-codes; reproduced at 0a776d2; not_reproduced at 447423c; scorecard: no_regression, median
tokens +24% (n=3); merged at 67ab6ce; promoted at a0b8576; outcome: accepted
turn-2 (solid line): case-id-is-a-valid-branch-name; reproduced at a0b8576; not_reproduced at 98719c3; scorecard: no_regression, median
tokens +0% (n=5); merged at 0cb62c0; promoted at 44f96a4; outcome: accepted
turn-3 (solid line): hours-bounds-a-harness-step; reproduced at a0b8576; not_reproduced at 9fb14cc; scorecard: no_regression, median
tokens -0% (n=5); merged at 76be9ed; promoted at 44f96a4; outcome: accepted
first turn accepted by validators (dashed line, square), 2026-10-19: self-improvement trial 2 drove a self.improvement/1 turn to accepted
with its candidate promoted, every claim recorded by a validator (takt 71f061c on impl/rsi-part-2); trials 3 and 4 did it again at 7a4d6b9 and
30bd2f0. In scratch: a scratch promotion store and install root, --forge none, main fast-forwarded by the operator. The installed takt
has not yet promoted a revision through a turn.
Data: 2026-10-18 (UTC), docs/metrics/scenario-runs.jsonl, 57 runs. One scenario, n per revision in the rows under the axis: first results,
not a benchmark. Untimed revisions have no wall time; tokens are summed over the invocations that reached the merge approval, resumes
included. Events: docs/metrics/events.jsonl, each with its run record.
